notes: The complete recovery_paths harness has 58 cases; the separate-process encode. filter selects 21. Both separate products used identical harness bytes and dependency lockfiles, independent target directories, and inspected generated sources.
The separate-process run used the rejected grouping draft and suffered large repeatability failures even in unchanged controls. None of its latency comparisons describes the delivered runtime.

Paired probes link both product snapshots into one process and execute adjacent A1/B1/B2/A2 phases per case. Each phase has 20 untimed warmups and three 150 ms samples in batches of eight; serial-only operations are measured.

To avoid Cargo package collisions, only the temporary baseline manifests changed package/workspace dependency version from 9.0.0 to 0.0.1. Every baseline Rust/build.rs source byte was verified against the 642217a snapshot; all common dependency versions and checksums match its committed lockfile. No product version was changed.
The rejected grouping draft retained samples but not iteration counts; it is diagnostic only. Its production-source delta from the retained runtime is embedded for reconstruction.

The fused distinct-buffer probe recorded a 4+2/1MiB slowdown. The final probe shares the identical buffer addresses between implementations to control data placement; that slowdown did not recur. Both probes remain visible.
Preflights compare baseline/candidate encoding bytes, verify through their independent arithmetic path, and poison output before re-encoding; final parity is verified again after all phases.

Host hardware resources were not reserved. Final paired results are local warm microbenchmark observations with two drift checks, not isolated-server, cold-cache, parallel, x86, browser, or downstream throughput guarantees.

The retained algorithm keeps all parity accumulators fused; grouping reduced stack accesses but introduced small-shard latency regressions in the draft. The retained template shares each input load/nibbles and hoists checked pointers instead of adding dispatch variants.
assembly_method: otool -tvV; identify generated-function backward-branch loops containing tbl and count q/d loads/stores based on sp/x29. Counts are per 16-byte offset across all outputs; they are instruction counts, not timing or stack-size claims.
